results.name: toolz-sliding-window
results.summary: Fixed the sliding_window function in toolz/itertoolz.py by changing the deque slice from i+1 to i. This ensures that the first window starts at index 0. All tests now pass.

results.name: more-itertools-tail
results.summary: Fixed the tail function in more_itertools/recipes.py by ensuring the start index for islice is non-negative when the requested tail length exceeds the iterable size. The change replaces `size - n` with `max(0, size - n)`. All tests pass, including the previously failing test_sized_less.

results.name: humanize-naturalsize
results.summary: Fixed the naturalsize function in src/humanize/filesize.py by setting the correct base (1000 for decimal, 1024 for binary) based on the mode. This ensures that decimal mode uses powers of 1000 (kB, MB, etc.) and binary mode uses powers of 1024 (KiB, MiB, etc.). All tests in tests/test_filesize.py no

results.name: jmespath-prefix-suffix
results.summary: Swapped the implementations of _func_ends_with and _func_starts_with in jmespath/functions.py. The ends_with function was incorrectly using str.startswith and starts_with was using str.endswith. After fixing, all function-related compliance tests pass.

results.name: click-intrange-clamp
results.summary: Fixed the IntRange clamping logic for open bounds by changing the _clamp method to add the direction instead of subtracting it. This corrects the behavior when clamp=True and min_open=True or max_open=True. The changes were made in src/click/types.py. All tests in tests/test_types/test_IntRange.py n

results.name: jinja-batch-filter
results.summary: Fixed the batch filter in src/jinja2/filters.py by changing the condition from `len(tmp) > linecount` to `len(tmp) == linecount` in the do_batch function. results.name: packaging-canonicalize
results.summary: Fixed canonicalize_name in src/packaging/utils.py by replacing '.' with '-' in addition to '_' before condensing repeated hyphens. This ensures PEP 503 compliance where periods are converted to hyphens. All tests now pass.

results.name: pyparsing-lineno
results.summary: Fixed the line number reporting in pyparsing.util.lineno by adding 1 to the count of newlines before the given location. This changes the line numbering from 0-based to 1-based as documented and expected by the tests. The failing test now passes, and the full test suite passes.

results.name: tomli-unicode-escape
results.summary: Fixed the parsing of \\uXXXX escape sequences in basic strings. The issue was in src/tomli/_parser.py where parse_hex_char was called with hex_len=3 for \\u escapes, but the TOML spec requires 4 hex digits. Changed hex_len from 3 to 4 for \\u escapes. All tests now pass.
